intent: Record as reviewed the URL fetch, duplicate and content hash rules the ingest Context enforces and tests.
observable_outcome: get-context ingest lists the rules as reviewed, each proven by its test.

acceptance_criteria.statement: An import from a URL accepts a package of exactly the zip ceiling and refuses one byte more.
An import from a URL follows at most three redirects and then stops.
Each redirect of an import fetch is checked against the allowed hosts again, so a redirect off the list is never followed.
An import URL holding a query, a fragment or credentials is refused before any request, without echoing them.
An import fetch never connects to a loopback, link-local or metadata address, even through an allowed host name or a redirect.
Saving content whose hash a version of the same Skill already holds returns that version as a duplicate and writes no new version.
A Skill that is one directory of a larger package is hashed over its own files only, so the same content hashes the same wherever it sits.
